title: Recipe for a City
subtitle: A pinch of park. A handful of doorsteps. Stir in a street.
description: Compose an original isometric neighborhood with eleven illustrated tiles, three small recipes, undoable edits, and honest shared-side road-graph notes. Keep a printable SVG or reopen your local JSON plan.
instruction: Choose an ingredient and an address, then place it. Read the road groups, try a small recipe, and keep your illustration.
